svg.metadata: Adapted from Arms_of_the_King_of_the_Romans_(c.1433-1486).svg by Tom Lemmens (Tom-L) and Heralder, https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Arms_of_the_King_of_the_Romans_(c.1433-1486).svg . CC BY-SA 3.0, https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/ . Fabelgeist contributors removed the shield, identified tongue paths and expanded the double eagle's mirrored wing with unique IDs. The double eagle retains the modern source's halos. Historical provenance and modification details: ../EAGLES.md.
